items.summary: Tropical Depression Twenty-One-E strengthened into Tropical Storm Trudy in NHC Advisory #2 (3:00 PM CST / 2100 UTC Tue Oct 13, i.e. 2:00 PM PDT). Max sustained winds 40 mph (gusts 50), 1005 mb, centered at 10.6N 96.5W - about 490 mi SSE of Acapulco and 780 mi SE of Manzanillo, moving NW at 8 mph; tropical-storm-force winds extend 45 mi from the center. No coastal watches or warnings in effect; NHC urges residents of southwestern and west-central Mexico to monitor Trudy's progress. Rapid intensification forecast: hurricane by Wednesday night, major hurricane by Friday (NHC-derived forecast: Wed 70 mph, Thu 105 mph, Fri-Sat 130 mph, Sun 115 mph). Hurricane Simon unchanged (Advisory #26: still Cat 1, 90 mph, 977 mb, drifting W at 2 mph ~110 mi W of Cabo Corrientes; no watch/warning changes).
items.title: Tropical Storm Trudy forms off southern Mexico; forecast to become a major hurricane by Friday
